subject: Re: Kickoff: DP-SGD clipping library hardening
body:
Wrap-up from the benchmark week and decisions:

1. fp16 handling: we shipped Umar's selector-side fix — grad_norm_computation_selector routes fp16 workloads away from the FFT path. Clean, and the matrix reflects shipping behavior as he wanted.
2. Headline numbers for the report: 40-55% peak-memory reduction across the conv architectures tested, with ghost norm the winner on 7 of 11 configs. That clears the OKR target.
3. Adoption: the two DP training pipelines we courted have both committed; Leilani's integration branch merges this week for the first one.
4. Slight annoyance for the retro — our reservation week started with ~6 hours of queue churn Monday morning before jobs placed cleanly. Flagging to Ines's team separately.

Benchmark report goes out June 12. This one's done — nice work.

Zofia
